==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*ǵneh₃-}}
In English (recorded only since 1656, but until the 19th century stigmatized as 'Scottish') apparently from {{m|en|narration}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/nəˈɹeɪt/|a=RP}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-narrate.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈnæɹeɪt/|/ˈnɛɹ.eɪt/|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/nəˈɹæɪt/|a=AU}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪt}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[relate]] (a story or series of events) in [[speech]] or [[writing]].
#: {{syn|en|tell}}
#: {{coi|en|'''narrate''' a story}}
#: {{coi|en|'''narrate''' a tale}}
#: {{coi|en|'''narrate''' one's life}}
#: {{coi|en|'''narrate''' the play}}
#: {{ux|en|The documentary will '''narrate''' the rise and fall of the historic club.}}
# To give an [[account]].
#: {{syn|en|report}}
#: {{coi|en|'''narrate''' the meeting}}
